routing.heading: Change models without moving your agent.
routing.copy: Point your OpenAI-compatible client at Tangle Router. Choose the model with each request, wherever your agent runs.

run-story.heading: Inspect the fix before you merge.
run-story.copy: Three tests failed in our example repo. One formatter crashed when a user was missing. Claude Code fixed it to return “anonymous,” repaired the other two bugs and ran the suite again. All nine tests passed.
